---
title: "London attractions dashboard"
format: dashboard
---

```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from IPython.display import Markdown

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("data/visits.csv")
churches = pd.read_csv("data/churches.csv")

top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
top_name = top["attraction"].split(" (")[0]
total_visits = f"{attractions['visits_2025'].sum():,}"
top_visits = f"{top['visits_2025']:,}"
n_free = int(attractions["admission"].str.startswith("Free").sum())
free_share = f"{n_free}/{len(attractions)}"
```

# Attractions

## Row {height=25%}

::: {.valuebox icon="trophy" color="primary"}
Most visited: `{python} top_name`

`{python} top_visits`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="people" color="info"}
Visits to the top 10 (ALVA members), 2025

`{python} total_visits`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="ticket-perforated" color="success"}
Top 10 with free entry

`{python} free_share`
:::

## Row {height=62%}

```{python}
#| title: "Visits in 2025, London's ten most visited ALVA member attractions"
fig = px.bar(
    attractions.sort_values("visits_2025"),
    x="visits_2025", y="attraction", orientation="h",
    labels={"visits_2025": "Visits in 2025", "attraction": ""},
)
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Visits per year, 2015–2025 (five big sights)"
fig = px.line(
    visits, x="year", y="visits", color="attraction", markers=True,
    labels={"visits": "Visits", "year": "", "attraction": ""},
).update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", entrywidth=175, x=0, y=-0.12, yanchor="top"))
fig
```

## Row {height=13%}

::: {.card}
Source: ALVA annual visits to member attractions,
[2025](https://www.alva.org.uk/details.cfm?p=423) and earlier years (see
`data/visits.csv`), retrieved 2026-10-30. 2020–2021 are pandemic years. From 2024
the Natural History Museum count includes its gardens.
:::

# Churches

## Row {height=80%}

```{python}
#| title: "Ten London churches tourists like, chosen by Visit London"
rows = [f"| {i} | [{c.church}]({c.visit_london}) | {c.type} |"
        for i, c in enumerate(churches.itertuples(), start=1)]
Markdown("\n".join(["| | Church | Type |", "|--:|---|---|", *rows]))
```

::: {.card title="Plan a visit"}
Each name opens its page on [Visit London](https://www.visitlondon.com/), the city's
official visitor guide. Opening times, services and tickets change, so check there before
you go.
:::

::: {.card}
Source: Visit London,
